items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: So they run Rap out of the studio and they got a cent for Charlie Cadilla. So it wound up Charlie Cadilla made the date. On the Victor. That date.

ctx.x: Now Barrettaria, you remember who the guys in the band? Rap was on that.
And what was he playing then? He was playing saxophone. Not clarinet. Charlie Cadilla was playing the sax, playing the clarinet. Rap was playing saxophone.
Was he playing alto or tenor?
